name: Ingrid Lindgren
headline: 34-year-old owner of a boutique hotel, caring for her mother in Stockholm, Sweden
description: Ingrid inherited a fortune from her grandparents and used part of it to buy a small hotel in Gamla Stan, which she runs with a sharp eye for profit margins and guest satisfaction. She lives with her mother, who has early-stage dementia, and has hired a night nurse so she can attend regional business conferences. Her competitiveness drives her to expand into a second property within two years, even if it means negotiating aggressively with contractors.
